title: Badge access
html:
Whoever took the painting needed a badge for the Salle des Etats (G4) and for the service corridor (SC), and was at work during the speeches, from 20:30 to 21:00.

Import staff.csv in Google Sheets and let a filter find these people. ·

The columns public_access and staff_access use the room codes from floorplan.png.

prev_card.title: You found the way out
prev_card.html:
The guard thinks the painting left through the service corridor, SC. Camera CAM-02 hangs there.

You used three kinds of file. staff.csv is structured: a table with the same columns on every row. cameras.xml is semi-structured: every value has a tag that says what it is. incident_report.txt is unstructured: plain text, so you had to read it yourself.

fields.label: Which employees had a badge for both G4 and SC, and were at work from 20:30 to 21:00? Give their employee IDs.

hints: Put one filter on each column: G4 is a public room, SC is staff only. You can filter several columns at once.

Data > Create a filter. In public_access choose Filter by condition > Text contains > G4. In staff_access choose Text contains > SC. Seven people remain. Of those, keep the ones whose shift_start is 20:30 or earlier and whose shift_end is 21:00 or later.
Four people: EMP-007, EMP-015, EMP-022, EMP-031.
